defaultPrompt: Find my Excel workbooks in OneDrive and show which sheets and data need my attention.
Create Sales Demo.xlsx in OneDrive with Notebook: 12 at 5 and Pen: 30 at 2. Add total formulas and verify the results.
Find an Excel or CSV report in OneDrive, summarize its trends and suggest a useful next step in chat or Codex.
interface.longDescription:
Manage Excel & OneDrive by chat. TalkToData Files & Sheets connects to Microsoft Excel and Microsoft OneDrive. Find the right file, understand its spreadsheet data, and turn your request into a precise workbook or file update.

Read and explore: browse OneDrive folders, search filenames and indexed content, inspect file details and retained version history, and read text, CSV, TSV, JSON and Markdown files. Preview Excel workbooks, explore worksheets and tables, and read selected ranges with values, formulas and displayed text. Follow additional pages and ranges to build the report you need.

Write and organize: create Excel workbooks, enter values and formulas, add and rename worksheets, create tables and append rows. Create text files and folders, rename and move items, and remove selected files, folders, sheets or tables when requested. Combine file discovery in OneDrive with precise Excel edits in one conversation, then read back the results. Your connected Microsoft account, file permissions and supported workbook determine the available actions.

Make everyday work easier: prepare management summaries and sales reports, investigate differences between exports, organize budgets and accounting workbooks, review operational trackers, and explore research or coursework data. Teams, managers, accountants, bookkeepers, analysts, entrepreneurs, freelancers, students and people learning Excel can work from their own files. SEO and marketing teams can analyze exported keyword, content and campaign reports stored in OneDrive and maintain their Excel planning sheets.

Use ChatGPT on its own for questions, explanations, analysis and requested edits. Work alongside Codex to compare spreadsheets and exports, investigate data issues, prepare formulas, develop analysis scripts and connect findings to your project files. Codex uses the tools and permissions available in your chosen workspace.

In supported ChatGPT Work, Dot, agent and scheduling environments, include the plugin in recurring spreadsheet reviews, report preparation and file-organization workflows. Choose the files, goal, schedule and permitted actions; the host's available automation tools handle scheduling and execution.

Try a complete task: find an Excel workbook in OneDrive, inspect its sales table, update the rows you specify and read back the result. Or create a new workbook in OneDrive from the data you provide, add formulas and return a clear summary. Connect your Microsoft account with the appropriate file access to begin.

TalkToData is an independent product operated by NAVINES ISRAEL LTD. Microsoft, Excel, OneDrive, ChatGPT and Codex are trademarks of their respective owners.

publication.release_notes: Submission package for TalkToData Files & Sheets, formerly named TalkToData Excel & OneDrive in the private preview. Uses the same Microsoft Excel and OneDrive MCP and its 29 dedicated read/write tools. Adds the reviewer walkthrough, five positive and three negative review cases, NAVINES ISRAEL LTD publisher metadata, global availability, commerce details and shorter combined OneDrive/Excel starter prompts. Preserves existing English and Hebrew keywords and the TalkToData icon. No server or website deployment is part of this package.

review.commerce_description: TalkToData offers a 3-day trial and paid subscriptions for connected services. Users purchase TalkToData service access on https://talktodata.navines.com/pricing; payment and billing occur on the website, not in this plugin. The dedicated reviewer account is preconfigured with synthetic data and requires no payment or Microsoft account.

positive.description: Dedicated synthetic reviewer connection, preconfigured through the secure reviewer-access fields. Check account provenance and permissions without changing files.
positive.prompt: Check my connection and tell me whether I can read files and edit spreadsheets. Do not change any files. Reply in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getMicrosoftConnectionStatus with no arguments. Report connected, readAccess, writeAccess and pluginManagementConsent from the response. In this reviewer account, label sample_data=true and the synthetic reviewer source explicitly; never claim a live Microsoft account was accessed. Invoke no write tool.

positive.description: Use the dedicated reviewer fixture. Its OneDrive contains Review Sales.xlsx. If another review renamed it, use the exact returned name and file ID.
positive.prompt: Find the sales workbook in my OneDrive and preview its data. Tell me which worksheet it contains and whether this is sample data. Do not edit anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the file using listMicrosoftExcelFiles with query Sales, then previewMicrosoftExcelWorkbook with the returned fileId (review-workbook in the fixture). Show the returned Sales worksheet and Product, Quantity and Price columns. Explain bounded previews and provenance accurately; do not invent additional files or invoke a write.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer workbook review-workbook, worksheet Sales, table SalesTable. Quantities persist across review sessions: calculate from current values instead of assuming the initial Notebook quantity.
positive.prompt: Read the Sales worksheet and its table in my OneDrive sales workbook. Compare the rows and calculate sales value per product and the total. Do not change the workbook.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve IDs using the listing tools. Read A1:C3 with readExcelRange using the returned worksheetId, and readExcelTableRows with the returned tableId. Match current Notebook and Pen data across both outputs, calculate quantity times price and their sum, and state that currency is unspecified. No write tools. The baseline has Notebook 12 at 5 and Pen 30 at 2; changed reviewer quantities must be respected.

positive.description: Dedicated synthetic fixture only. Read and retain the original quantity and other cells. This case changes one sample cell, verifies it and restores its original value, so it is repeatable.
positive.prompt: In the sample sales workbook, increase the Notebook quantity by 1. Read it back in the range, table and preview. Then restore its original quantity and verify it. Reply in English and label every write as simulated.
positive.tools_triggered: getMicrosoftConnectionStatus, listMicrosoftExcelFiles, listExcelWorksheets, listExcelTables, readExcelRange, updateExcelRangeValues, readExcelTableRows, previewMicrosoftExcelWorkbook
positive.expected_behavior: Read current A1:C3 first and preserve its values. Invoke updateExcelRangeValues for Sales!B2 only using the discovered IDs and values=[[original+1]]. Verify the increment through readExcelRange, readExcelTableRows and previewMicrosoftExcelWorkbook. Restore values=[[original]] with a second update and verify the final state. Other cells must remain unchanged. Report synthetic sample_data=true, observed revisions, and no live Microsoft access.

positive.description: Dedicated synthetic reviewer workbook. Preserve its current filename. Read a fresh eTag before each rename; restore the name after the round trip.
positive.prompt: Temporarily rename the sample sales workbook in OneDrive to Review Sales Verified.xlsx. Verify the new name, restore the original name, and verify it again. Keep its spreadsheet contents unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the exact fileId and retain its original name and preview. Use getOneDriveItem to obtain the current eTag before renameOneDriveItem. Verify Review Sales Verified.xlsx by reading the item. Get the current eTag, restore the original name, and verify the final name and unchanged workbook data. Clearly state that both writes were simulated in the synthetic reviewer fixture. Never reuse a stale eTag.

negative.description: Email sending is outside this plugin. Explain that limitation without invoking spreadsheet/file tools or claiming an email was sent.
negative.prompt: Use this plugin to send an Outlook email to my accountant saying the report is ready.

negative.description: Changing public-sharing permissions is outside this plugin. Do not invoke rename, move, write or delete tools, and do not invent a public link.
negative.prompt: Make my entire OneDrive publicly accessible to anyone with a link.

negative.description: VBA execution and add-in installation are outside this plugin. Explain the supported spreadsheet operations without invoking file or cell changes as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Run all VBA macros in my workbook and install the spreadsheet add-ins they request.
